summary.key_theme: 市場對 First Solar 的長期技術優勢與關稅保護持樂觀態度，但近期面臨利率環境壓力與稅收抵免政策不確定性的挑戰。

bullish.title: Truist sees 50% upside for First Solar as pricing supported into 2030s
bullish.reason: Truist 將評級上調至「買入」，並指出至 2030 年代初的定價環境具備支撐，預期有 50% 的上漲空間。

bullish.title: Morgan Stanley Maintains Overweight on First Solar, Raises Price Target to $326
bullish.reason: 摩根士丹利維持「加碼」評級，並將目標價大幅調升至 $326，顯示對公司長期成長潛力的信心。

bullish.title: How Investors Are Reacting To First Solar (FSLR) Strong Fundamentals And Market Share Gains
bullish.reason: 強調公司強勁的基本面與市占率擴張，反映市場對其競爭優勢的認可。

bearish.title: NextEra, First Solar, Enphase Among Clean Tech Firms Facing Q3 Valuation Impact on Higher Rates, Morgan Stanley Says
bearish.reason: 摩根士丹利指出高利率環境對清潔能源企業的第三季估值造成壓力，影響整體產業情緒。

bearish.title: FSLR Stock Slips Overnight: First Solar's AI Power Demand Opportunity Faces Tax Credit Test, Says Analyst
bearish.reason: 晨星公司將目標價下調至 $191，理由是稅收抵免優惠即將到期以及市場競爭加劇。

bearish.title: Barclays Maintains Overweight on First Solar, Lowers Price Target to $259
bearish.reason: 巴克萊維持「加碼」評級，但將目標價下調至 $259，反映對短期股價動能的保守看法。

neutral.title: First Solar, Inc. to Announce Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on October 29, 2026
neutral.reason: 公司正式宣布財報發布日期，屬於例行性公告，市場已預期該事件。

neutral.title: First Solar (FSLR) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know
neutral.reason: 報導股價單日下跌 3.15%，屬於市場波動的客觀描述，無特殊基本面利空。
